ache.title: Patch notes on Christmas Day? Oh, Nero
ache.note: Posted on Christmas Day, straight from the Japanese site: Eldegoss buffs, Ceruledge adjustments, notable nerfs for Darkrai and Psyduck. Swings like these make what you own feel shaky and the newly buffed pick tempting. And reading them on a holiday? That’s the loop pulling up a chair at dinner.
watch: nerfs that shrink what you own
buffs that tempt a new pick
ache.tip: Patches can wait until after the holiday. Spend today with people, not patch notes.
lines: nerfed today, buffed tomorrow. a swing
the patch will be there after dinner

title: Post-Christmas Patch: Scizor & Darkrai | Pokémon Unite
excerpt: In this video, I share my first impressions of the latest Pokémon Unite patch, straight from the Japanese website. From Eldegoss buffs to Ceruledge adjustments, and significant changes for Pokémon like Buzzwole, Scizor, Blastoise, and Inteleon, there's a lot to dive into. Some Pokémon like Darkrai and Psyduck received notable nerfs, altering the game balance significantly. Join me as I break down each change and discuss its potential impact on gameplay. Let me know your thoughts on these...
